title: Greetings
goal: Open an interaction, answer a short check-in, and greet someone again after time apart.

title: Making Introductions
goal: Give your name, connect your name to a useful detail, and introduce another person.

title: Conversation Fillers and Listening Signals
goal: Give yourself thinking time, organize a turn, and show how you are following another person's story.

title: Saying You Don't Understand
goal: Explain what you missed and ask for repetition, slower speech or a clearer explanation.

title: Opinions and Preferences
goal: Say what you like, give an opinion, choose between options, or explain that either choice works for you.

title: Agreeing and Disagreeing
goal: Show agreement, express a different view with the strength you intend, and decide how to continue a disagreement.

title: Making Suggestions and Invitations
goal: Propose an activity, invite someone, and respond with acceptance, a refusal, uncertainty or another idea.

title: Saying Thank You
goal: Thank someone for a specific action, respond to thanks, and distinguish gratitude from a literal request or a frustrated reaction.

title: Saying Sorry
goal: Acknowledge your own mistake, respond to an apology, and distinguish an apology from sympathy or a request for repetition.

title: Saying Goodbye
goal: End an encounter, acknowledge the time together, and make clear whether future contact is a plan or a general wish.

title: Dates, Time, and Weather
goal: Read and say a date or time clearly, describe how often something happens, and recognize a useful set of weather words.

title: Making Arrangements
goal: Find a time that works, confirm the important details, and change an arrangement when necessary.

title: Talking About the Weather
goal: Describe conditions, react to someone else's weather comment, and distinguish a forecast from what is happening now.

title: Family and Relationships
goal: Choose family and relationship words that accurately describe a person or connection.

title: Talking About Family
goal: Describe family relationships and contact, ask a useful follow-up, or keep personal information private.

title: Life Events
goal: Recognize the news someone shares and respond with celebration, a good wish, acknowledgment or sympathy.

title: Socializing
goal: Join a social conversation, discover a connection, follow up on an answer, and leave or change the topic when you want.

title: Dating and Romance
goal: Make or clarify a date invitation, express interest or refusal, discuss expectations, and close the encounter honestly.

title: Showing Support
goal: Acknowledge a difficulty, encourage someone without promising an outcome, and offer or respond to practical help.

title: Eating and Drinking
goal: Retrieve a useful set of drink, equipment, preparation and menu words for the food task you want to do.

title: Cafés and Coffee Shops
goal: Order a drink or snack, answer the options offered, and manage a simple pickup or seating question.

title: Takeout and Delivery
goal: Place or collect a food order, confirm delivery details, and report a delay or missing item.

title: Bars and Pubs
goal: Order a drink, ask about the choices and payment, buy a round, or decline another drink.

title: At a Restaurant
goal: Reserve or request a table, order with relevant needs, explain a problem, and settle the check.

title: Cooking and Eating
goal: Follow and clarify cooking steps, share tasks, and talk with a host about food and preferences.

title: Free Time and Hobbies
goal: Name leisure activities, understand a few less familiar choices, and choose words for your own interests.

title: At the Movie Theater
goal: Choose a showing, buy tickets, ask about seating or access, and discuss the movie afterward.

title: At the Theater
goal: Collect or choose tickets, find your seats, ask about the performance, and manage the intermission.

title: Concerts and Festivals
goal: Find performers and facilities, understand an entry request, and arrange a meeting at a busy event.

title: At the Gym
goal: Ask about membership and classes, decide whether to join, and request help during a first visit.

title: Sports and Recreation
goal: Join or decline a game, ask about a lesson or facility, and use clear language during a team activity.

title: Sports Events
goal: Ask about event tickets and seating, make a viewing plan, and react while watching a game.

title: Hobbies
goal: Ask about someone's interests, explain what you do for fun, and talk about starting or continuing a hobby.

title: Shops and Services
goal: Recognize useful places and payment words, then use a selected set to explain what you need.

title: At the Market
goal: Ask about a product and quantity, discuss a price, and accept or decline an offer.

title: At the Supermarket
goal: Find or request a grocery item, answer checkout questions, and explain a simple scanning or product problem.

title: At the Garden Center
goal: Explain the kind of plant you want and ask about its needs before choosing.

title: At the Hardware Store
goal: Describe a home project, ask where to find supplies, and ask for clarification about a product.

title: Buying Clothes and Shoes
goal: Ask about an item, size and availability; describe fit; and decide whether to buy.

title: Returning Goods
goal: Explain why you are returning an item, ask about a refund or exchange, and respond when the first option is unavailable.

title: Hair, Beauty, and Grooming
goal: Make an appointment, explain the result you want, and clarify a stylist's suggestion before agreeing.

title: Sending and Receiving
goal: Ask about mailing or collecting an item, clarify delivery options, and report a delivery problem.

title: Money and Finance
goal: Ask about an account or payment, describe a card problem, and clarify a money transaction.

title: At the Library
goal: Ask about joining a library, find or borrow material, and clarify a library service.

title: Work and Study
goal: Recognize selected job, education and employment terms and use them to describe a situation or ask a question.

title: At School
goal: Ask about a school, take part in a first-day introduction, and discuss a child's progress with a teacher.

title: College and Further Study
goal: Compare study options, ask about a program, navigate the first days, and seek practical or social support.

title: Looking for Work
goal: Ask about an opening, explain the work you want, and answer initial questions about experience and availability.

title: Applying for a Job
goal: Prepare short application text from supplied facts, follow a stated submission request, and explain an application problem.

title: Job Interviews
goal: Give relevant answers about your background and strengths, clarify a question, and ask about the role.

title: Starting a New Job
goal: Introduce yourself on the first day, clarify instructions, and discuss how the work is going.

title: In the Workplace
goal: Coordinate a routine or shift change, report a work problem, and confirm the agreed next action.

title: Giving a Presentation
goal: Deliver a connected short presentation with a clear purpose, organized points and an ending, then handle a question.

title: Work Meetings
goal: Contribute to a meeting, manage a turn, clarify a proposal and confirm the agreed next action.

title: Online Meetings
goal: Check participation in an online meeting, take a turn and explain a connection or screen-sharing problem.

title: Home
goal: Recognize selected housing, room and furniture terms and use them to describe a place or need.

title: Finding a New Home
goal: Explain housing needs, ask about a property or rental, and clarify an offer or ongoing housing concern.

title: Moving
goal: Coordinate packing and moving, clarify where belongings go, and discuss timing or a moving-service question.

title: Meeting the Neighbors
goal: Introduce yourself as a neighbor, respond to an invitation, and exchange a useful local question.

title: Household Chores
goal: Discuss who does a chore, ask about progress, and renegotiate an arrangement clearly.

title: Home Improvements
goal: Report progress on a home project and ask a professional about the scope, cost and timing of work.

title: Pets
goal: Ask about adopting an animal, describe a pet's observed problem, and ask for clear care information.

title: Home Emergencies
goal: Describe an urgent household problem, give its location and timing, and clarify the help being arranged.

title: Home Entertainment
goal: Choose something to watch or play, discuss controls and device problems, and negotiate a break or stopping time.

title: Getting Around
goal: Name a way to travel, recognize a travel location, and describe a ticket or delay.

title: Buses and Intercity Buses
goal: Check a bus's destination, ask about payment, identify your stop, and ask about a longer trip.

title: Trains and Subways
goal: Choose a train, ask about tickets and transfers, and understand a service change.

title: At the Airport
goal: Ask for help through an airport journey, understand key crew language, and give arrival information.

title: Bikes and Cycling
goal: Explain what kind of bike you need, arrange a rental, and describe a problem without guessing a repair.

title: Taxis and Rides
goal: Arrange a ride, give a destination, confirm pickup details, and handle a change or missing item.

title: At the Auto Repair Shop
goal: Schedule service, describe a car problem, ask for an explanation, and agree on the next step.

title: Vacation Vocabulary
goal: Select words for accommodation, packing, activities, and sightseeing, then describe a possible trip.

title: Booking a Vacation
goal: Describe the trip you want, compare an offer, and ask about conditions before deciding.

title: Staying in a Hotel
goal: Check in, ask about the room and services, report a problem, and review the bill at checkout.

title: City Sightseeing
goal: Ask about an attraction, choose an admission option, and follow a short sightseeing explanation.

title: Going Camping
goal: Find your reserved campsite, ask about facilities and current rules, and request supplies.

title: At the Beach
goal: Ask about beach conditions and facilities, arrange an activity, and choose whether to participate.

title: Finding Your Way
goal: Ask for directions, follow a short route, and check a location you are unsure about.

title: Travel Problems
goal: Report a missing item or travel disruption, ask about options, and explain a health-related change of plan.

title: Health and Medicine Vocabulary
goal: Name selected body parts, symptoms, professionals, and care-related terms to describe a concern and ask a question.

title: At the Pharmacy
goal: Describe a concern, collect a prescription, and ask a pharmacist to explain medicine instructions.

title: Booking a Health Appointment
goal: Request a medical or dental visit, describe the reason briefly, and confirm or change its arrangements.

title: Seeing a Healthcare Provider
goal: Report symptoms and concerns accurately, ask about an examination or care plan, and check the next step.

title: Injuries and Emergencies
goal: State an urgent problem and location, answer key emergency questions, and report an injury without choosing its diagnosis.

title: At the Hospital
goal: Identify your visit, give important information, ask about a procedure, and report recovery needs.

title: Dental Care
goal: Describe a dental concern, understand examination language, and ask about a proposed treatment.

title: Mental Health Support
goal: Ask for support, describe your experience, and state what you are ready to discuss.

title: Media and Communication Vocabulary
goal: Name a communication channel, device, online action, or reading item and explain what you need.

title: Professional and Service Calls
goal: Identify yourself and your purpose, manage a transfer or message, and confirm what happens after a call.

title: Familiar Phone Calls
goal: Start a familiar call, check availability, coordinate a plan, and handle connection or battery problems.

title: Using the Internet
goal: Ask about internet access, explain an online task, and clarify a form or request before acting.

title: Digital Problems
goal: Report a digital failure, separate observations from guesses, and ask support about the next step.

title: Emails
goal: check what happened to a message, write a clear email with a specific request, and respond to it.

title: Messaging and Video Calls
goal: send a useful short message, manage a group conversation, and ask for a change during a video call.

title: Social Media
goal: talk about online content, choose a response to contact, and explain a simple content idea.

title: Books and Reading
goal: describe your reaction to a book, ask for a suitable recommendation, and handle a bookstore or subscription question.
